transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

Honestly, I've just completely lost interest in all the things I used to enjoy, and I've been feeling really down and unmotivated. This has been going on for about eight months now. I just can't seem to find the desire to do anything anymore.
Have you had these symptoms continuously for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two years, or has it been more episodic?

It has definitely been continuous and pretty much every single day, rather than coming and going. However, it hasn't been going on for two years. It's only been about eight months since this all started.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself or that life isn't worth living?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of harming myself or ending my life. I definitely feel very down and empty, but I've never wanted to hurt myself.
When good things happen, like spending time with loved ones or hearing positive news, do you still feel a bit of improvement in your mood, or does the sadness remain unchanged?

My mood remains completely unchanged and flat, even when I'm spending time with loved ones or hearing good news. I feel completely unable to experience any happiness, satisfaction, or pleasure right now. That feeling of emptiness just persists no matter what happens around me.
Do you also find it difficult to look forward to anything or feel motivated, even for small daily tasks or future plans?

Yes, absolutely. I struggle to find the motivation for even the simplest daily tasks, and everything just feels like a massive chore. I also feel completely flat, and it has been impossible for me to look forward to or feel any excitement about future plans.

During the past two years, have there been any periods lasting at least two months where you did not feel depressed or lost interest in things, or has your low mood been present most of the time without significant breaks?
Before these past eight months, I felt completely normal. But since this started eight months ago, I have been feeling this way continuously without any breaks at all.
